title: Glazed Cranberry Orange Muffins

ingredientGroups.title: Muffins
items: 1 cup unsalted butter, room temperature (230 g)
½ cup packed light brown sugar (100 g)

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a muffin pan.
Beat butter on high about 1 minute until creamy. Add granulated and brown sugars; beat on high about 2 minutes, scraping the bowl.
Add eggs, sour cream or yogurt and vanilla; beat on medium for 1 minute, then on high until uniform. Beat in orange zest.
Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Slowly whisk in the wet mixture, then orange juice and milk until just combined. Fold in cranberries.
Fill muffin liners to the top; add extra cranberries if desired. Bake 5 minutes at 425°F, then lower the oven to 350°F and bake 17–18 minutes more, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Whisk glaze ingredients and drizzle over warm muffins. Let cool briefly before serving.
